newsitem.title: FRANCE: MOTOR RACING-BRUNDLE FASTEST IN LE MANS PRE-QUALIFYING.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-BRUNDLE FASTEST IN LE MANS PRE-QUALIFYING.

text.p: Former champion Martin
Brundle set the fastest time on Sunday in pre-qualifying for
June's Le Mans 24 Hours sportscar race.
Brundle, who this year lost his Jordan Formula One drive to
Germany's Ralf Schumacher, took his factory Nissan in the
closing moments of the two-day session to a 219.402 kph lap,
clocking 3 minutes 43.152 seconds on the road circuit.
"It was the perfect lap," the British driver, who won Le
Mans in 1990 in a Jaguar, said. "I thought perhaps a 3:43.5 lap
might be on but I didn't expect to run 3:43.152."
Italy's Michele Alboreto was second-fastest in a Joest
TWR-Porsche prototype and Frenchman Yannick Dalmas, three times
winner of Le Mans, third in a factory Porsche. The race is on
June 14/15.
Sunday's fastest 24 join Saturday's fastest 24 going forward
to race week. Finland's J.J.Lehto set the fastest time on
Saturday of 3:45.973 in a BMW McLaren. Sunday's times were
considerably quicker in cooler weather.
Sunday's leading times:
1. Martin Brundle (Britain) Nissan R390 GT1 3 minutes
43.152 seconds (219.402 kph)
2. Michele Alboreto (Italy) Joest TWR Porsche
3. Yannick Dalmas (France) Porsche 911 GT1
4. Didier Theys (Belgium) Ferrari 333SP
5. Peter Kox (Netherlands) BMW McLaren F1 GTR
6. Pedro Lamy (Portugal) Porsche 911 GT1
7. Jean-Marc Gounon (France) Gulf McLaren F1 GTR
8. Didier Cottaz (France) Courage Porsche C41
9. David Brabham (Australia) Ford Panoz GTR
10. Juergen von Gartzen (Germany) JB Porsche 911 GT1
